title: Celularity Inc 8-K Filing — 2026-04-21
summary: Celularity Inc filed an 8-K disclosing an amendment to its asset purchase and license agreement with NexGel, Inc. (total consideration $13.3M), an exchange notice from Helena Global Investment Opportunities converting preferred stock into a $1.97M convertible note, and a subsequent event of default notice related to late 10-K filing.
key_points: Amendment No. 1 to Asset Purchase and Exclusive License Agreement with NexGel provides $13.3M total consideration ($8.3M cash upfront, $5.0M convertible note).
First milestone payment of $2.5M triggered upon $25M net sales or 15 months, contingent on $15M net sales achieved.
Helena Global Investment Opportunities exchanged Series A Convertible Preferred Stock for a $1,970,502.58 convertible note bearing 18% annual interest, maturing October 16, 2026.
Helena delivered an event of default notice on April 17, 2026 citing failure to timely file the 10-K for fiscal year 2025.
Default cure period is 5 business days; Mandatory Default Amount equals 115% of outstanding principal plus accrued interest.
Company intends to cure the default within the applicable period.
